title: ZEUS Leave and Benefits Guide
content:
ZEUS Leave and Benefits Guide · Page 1
Section 1: Leave requests and carryover
Annual leave is requested in the People Portal at least 5 working days before the first day away. A manager responds within 2 working days. Unused annual leave carryover follows the 5-day limit in zeus-handbook, Section 1. Employees who change teams retain their existing balance. Contact People Operations when a portal balance differs from a signed leave approval. The company observes 11 paid public holidays each year; the calendar is published by 1 December for the following year.
